Case note: Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2883/2020
Client: Vandana Mukherjee (mechanical engineer, Nashik)
Opposing party: Harish More
Court: Nashik Sessions Court
Filed on: 31 August 2020
Claim amount: INR 74,80,000/-
Issue: anticipatory bail. The complainant alleges cheating over a failed deal.
Advice given: Produce the contract and payment records to show there was no intent to cheat at the outset.
Outcome: Bail was granted because the dispute was about performance of a contract.
Recommended next step: Seek quashing of the complaint.
Witness: Uma Menon
